blocks.heading: What today is
blocks.body: About 90 minutes. Do the lab in the app. The check at the end uses words from today only.

blocks.heading: The same mistake, twice
blocks.body:
Grammar tells you a how-to may not want an explaining-page body. It does not tell you that the short line under the title should not start with “This topic”.

**Schematron** is a rules file that flags the same mistake. A shop writes the rule once. Oxygen shows it every time. That is a house rule, compiled.

If you have no file yet, write a pretend one and label it pretend. Do not paste a stranger’s 200-line file into git.

A **Quick Fix** can rewrite the page to match the rule. Click it only when you can say what will change.

lessons.title: One house rule, in your words

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: You copy a long rules file from a forum as ‘the rule’, or you skip writing the rule in your own words.

Expected: One assert in your words, real or pretend. Pretend is labeled pretend.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 1
steps.body: If you have a Schematron file at work, open one rule. Write what it flags, in plain words, in oxygen-bootcamp-work/week8/house-rule.txt.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: If you do not have one, write a pretend rule and label it pretend: the short line under the title must not start with ‘This topic’.

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Write one sentence: Schematron is a rules file that flags the same mistake. Grammar will not catch ‘This topic’. This file can.

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Do not paste a long rules file from a forum into your folder and call it the shop rule.

blocks.summary: One assert in your words, real or pretend. Pretend is labeled pretend.

blocks.q: A page is well-formed and valid, but the short line under the title starts with ‘This topic’. Who can flag that?
options: The grammar of the page type :  it already blocks those words
A house rules file (Schematron). Grammar will not catch wording. This file can
blocks.why: Well-formed is the skeleton. Valid is the page type. House rules are extra. That is the point.

blocks.q: A yellow bulb offers a Quick Fix on a house rule. When do you click it?
options: Only when you can say what it will change
blocks.why: Some fixes are fine. Some rewrite the page. If you cannot say what will change, Undo is cheaper.
